_comment: Per-row outcome class overrides for the Excel shadow runner. Keyed by '<sheetName>:<rowId>'. Each entry is { componentIndex, outcomeClass, reason }. Overrides take precedence over the heuristic classifier in classifyScenario.ts. Add an entry only when the heuristic gets a row wrong; the build-time report tracks how many overrides exist as a signal of heuristic accuracy.

Specific Scenarios:SPC-99999.reason: Row has a PI% but the description is ambiguous between two clinical interpretations; the assistant should ask before calculating.

Scenario Catalogue:SCN-1098.reason: Vestibulocochlear/equilibrium workbook bracket description ('Moderate equilibrium impairment, limitation required of all daily activities for a very short period') uses non-clinical severity language the CNS extractor does not bracket-match. Assistant routes correctly but requests clarification on severity; overriding expected class to routing_only so the calibration reflects actual system behaviour.

Scenario Catalogue:SCN-1106.reason: CNS Section B respiration row uses workbook category phrasing ('Respiration related to neurological impairment: Individual is capable of spontaneous respiration but only with continuing medical support'). Extractor routes to CNS but the bracket-match requires the doctor to confirm ventilatory status; override to routing_only to reflect actual outcome.

Scenario Catalogue:SCN-1108.reason: Same as SCN-1106 — CNS Section B respiration bracket not matched from workbook abstract phrasing ('no capacity for spontaneous respiration'). Routes correctly; override to routing_only.

Scenario Catalogue:SCN-1139.reason: Diplopia row uses abstract workbook phrasing ('Diplopia not reasonably correctable by prisms or surgery') rather than clinical zone terminology (uncorrectable / central 30° / 30-60° / beyond 60°). Visual extractor routes correctly but cannot assign a diplopia zone without zone-explicit language; override to routing_only.

Scenario Catalogue:SCN-1141.reason: Diplopia row uses abstract workbook phrasing ('expected to be reasonably corrected by surgery between 30 and 60 degrees') rather than the canonical '30-60 degrees' zone marker. Visual extractor routes correctly but no zone extraction; override to routing_only.
